declarations.name: QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.boundary1Matrix.eq_2
declarations.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} {rowOne : Type u_2} {colOne : Type u_3} {rowTwo : Type u_4} {colTwo : Type u_5} [inst : Field F]
  [inst_1 : Fintype rowOne] [inst_2 : DecidableEq rowOne] [inst_3 : Fintype colOne] [inst_4 : DecidableEq colOne]
  [inst_5 : Fintype rowTwo] [inst_6 : DecidableEq rowTwo] [inst_7 : Fintype colTwo] [inst_8 : DecidableEq colTwo]
  (D : QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.Data F rowOne colOne rowTwo colTwo) (r₁ : rowOne) (c₂ : colTwo) (r₁' : rowOne)
  (r₂ : rowTwo),
  QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.boundary1Matrix D (r₁, c₂) (Sum.inr (r₁', r₂)) = if r₁ = r₁' then -D.second r₂ c₂ else 0

  (H : QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.Data (ZMod 2) R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂),
  Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (HGPExperiment.ZLogical H) =
